action_history.rationale: Step 0 with 12 initial data points and batch size 16 (>10). The yield landscape is highly skewed with a sharp peak (max 82.16 vs median 2.35), suggesting a localized optimum in T-pH space. Thompson sampling is ideal for this large batch: it provides natural diversity across the search space while probabilistically favoring the promising high-yield region. With no budget constraint and sparse data (12 points, 2D), we want broad coverage with exploitation bias. Matern-2.5 suits the expected smooth-but-peaked chemical yield surface. Low noise floor lets the GP learn freely — the extreme variation is likely real signal, not measurement noise.
